pull.title: cmake: Reject warnings in `check_cxx_source_compiles_with_flags()`, use `-msse4.1` for SHA-NI
pull.body:
This is a prerequisite for #31507.

1. The first commit fixes a bug in the C++ atomic library check:
```console
$ git rev-parse HEAD
01b51c0f1fa8af242fc37891d666c3d940045d80

-- Performing Test STD_ATOMIC_NEEDS_LINK_TO_LIBATOMIC
-- Performing Test STD_ATOMIC_NEEDS_LINK_TO_LIBATOMIC - Failed
CMake Error at cmake/module/TestAppendRequiredLibraries.cmake:91 (message):
  Cannot figure out how to use std::atomic.
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  cmake/introspection.cmake:23 (test_append_atomic_library)
  CMakeLists.txt:453 (include)


-- Configuring incomplete, errors occurred!
```

```console
        FAILED: [code=1] CMakeFiles/cmTC_88170.dir/src.cxx.o 
        /usr/lib64/ccache/c++ -DHAVE_SSE42  -msse4.2 -O2 -g -std=c++20 -fPIE -o CMakeFiles/cmTC_88170.dir/src.cxx.o -c /home/hebasto/dev/bitcoin/build/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-fn8wHI/src.cxx  -Wconversion -Werror

        /home/hebasto/dev/bitcoin/build/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-fn8wHI/src.cxx:11:22: error: conversion from ‘uint64_t’ {aka ‘long unsigned int’} to ‘unsigned int’ may change value [-Werror=conversion]

           12 |     l = _mm_crc32_u32(l, 0);
              |                       ^
        /home/hebasto/dev/bitcoin/build/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-fn8wHI/src.cxx:14:12: error: conversion from ‘uint64_t’ {aka ‘long unsigned int’} to ‘int’ may change value [-Werror=conversion]
           14 |     return l;
              |            ^
        cc1plus: all warnings being treated as errors
        ninja: build stopped: subcommand failed.
        
      exitCode: 1
```

4. We expect that neither the compiler flags nor the test source triggers any warnings, such as `-Wunknown-argument`. Therefore, append `working_compiler_werror_flag`, as done in [`try_append_cxx_flags()`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/cmake/module/TryAppendCXXFlags.cmake).

5. `-msse4` is merely a synonym for `-msse4.2` in both GCC and Clang, but it is not accepted by the clang-cl frontend. Furthermore, the x86 SHA-NI code uses only SSE4.1 intrinsics and no SSE4.2 ones.

Replace `-msse4` with `-msse4.1` to resolve both issues.

The absence of SSE4.2 usage can be verified by building with `-DAPPEND_CXXFLAGS=-mno-sse4.2`.

cmake: Add `[[maybe_unused]]` annotation to atomic library check

The check fails when `-Wall -Werror` are provided by the user as the
unused `d1` variable triggers `-Wunused-variable`. Since the fallback
check with `LINK_LIBRARIES atomic` compiles the same source, it fails
too, and configuration aborts with "Cannot figure out how to use
std::atomic."

cmake, crypto: Use `-msse4.1` instead of `-msse4` for x86 SHA-NI

`-msse4` is merely a synonym for `-msse4.2` in both GCC and Clang, but
it is not accepted by the clang-cl frontend. Furthermore, the x86
SHA-NI code uses only SSE4.1 intrinsics and no SSE4.2 ones.

Replace `-msse4` with `-msse4.1` to resolve both issues.

The absence of SSE4.2 usage can be verified by building with
`-DAPPEND_CXXFLAGS=-mno-sse4.2`.

events.body:
A new commit has been added to fix warnings in the SSE4.2 check, which effectively addresses ralph's [feedback](https://git.fish.foo/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36554#issuecomment-610927):
> Make the CRC32C probe warning-free ...
